sum: BIL VYAPAR LIMITED disclosed the outcome of its 15th Committee of Creditors meeting under CIRP, signalling continued negotiations toward a resolution plan.
detail: BIL VYAPAR LIMITED (NSE: BINANIIND), a listed company, notified the stock exchange on 3 July 2026 of the outcome of the 15th meeting of its Committee of Creditors during an ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The disclosure does not specify the resolution plan voted, approval counts, or forward timeline. The progression to a 15th CoC meeting suggests extended deliberations among the creditor body.
